_comment: Copy to rutm.config.json (gitignored) and fill in real secrets. These are the shared settings applied to every RUTM08; the site name + label password are typed into the UI per device (no manifest CSV).
_comment_lan: Applied as the LAST step: the LAN interface moves to lan_ip and the device drops off 192.168.1.1. The tool renews the laptop's DHCP lease and confirms the device answers on the new address. The detection loop also watches lan_ip, so an already-moved router can be re-run (leave the label password empty — it is on the shared password).
_comment_internet: FOTA, RMS registration and Tailscale need internet, which a RUTM08 gets over its WAN port — plug WAN into a live uplink on the bench. wait_for_internet makes the tool poll until the link is up (up to internet_timeout seconds) before those steps.

firmware._comment: mode = fota (device pulls latest-stable from Teltonika — needs WAN internet), local (upload a pinned .bin from this machine), rms (defer — registered device upgrades itself on first RMS connect), or none. keep_settings must stay true: a settings wipe would reset a moved device back to 192.168.1.1 mid-run.

rms._comment_auth_code: Optional per-company RMS authentication code. Leave blank if you register devices via the API below — then they connect by serial+MAC without a code.
rms._comment_api: api_token must be an RMS Personal Access Token with the 'devices:read' + 'devices:write' scopes, and the account must have 2FA enabled (else the API returns 403). device_series is the RMS device family — 'rutm' for RUTM08; if RMS rejects the registration with an unknown-series error, try 'rut'.
rms._comment_pack: Optional license: assign a Management pack right after registration (the RMS UI's Actions -> Device -> 'Set pack'). Accepts the RMS pack type name ('management_3y' = Paid Management pack 3y.), a numeric credit_type_id, or a fragment of the display name. Leave empty to keep credit-based management. NOTE: packs cannot be revoked once assigned; the step skips devices that already carry a matching pack.

tailscale._comment_key: Either paste a single reusable auth_key, OR set mint_per_device + an api_key/tailnet to mint a fresh pre-authorized key per device via the Tailscale API (recommended).
